IPO_SYSCALL_REGISTER.description: Dynamically registers a custom system call handler into the kernel dispatch table.
IPO_SYSCALL_REGISTER.return: 0 on success, negative error code on failure

IPO_SYSCALL_CALL.description: Indirect invocation mechanism to dispatch a syscall through kernel dispatcher.

IPO_SYSCALL_PRINT.description: Outputs text to active VGA console and mirrors to COM1 serial.
IPO_SYSCALL_PRINT.return: Number of printed characters, or negative error code

IPO_SYSCALL_WRITE.description: Writes raw byte stream into an open file descriptor or console.
IPO_SYSCALL_WRITE.return: Bytes written, or negative on failure

IPO_SYSCALL_FS_CREATE.description: Creates a new empty file or directory in IPO_FS.
IPO_SYSCALL_FS_CREATE.return: 0 on success, negative error code otherwise

IPO_SYSCALL_FS_OPEN.description: Opens an existing inode and allocates a process file descriptor.
IPO_SYSCALL_FS_OPEN.return: Allocated file descriptor index (>= 0), or negative on error

IPO_SYSCALL_FS_READ.description: Reads data from storage extents into memory buffer.
IPO_SYSCALL_FS_READ.return: Bytes read into buffer, or negative error

IPO_SYSCALL_FS_WRITE.description: Writes data into file extents, allocating new blocks from bitmap as needed.
IPO_SYSCALL_FS_WRITE.return: Bytes written to storage, or negative error code

IPO_SYSCALL_FS_DELETE.description: Deletes file or directory, frees extents in bitmap and clears inode.
IPO_SYSCALL_FS_DELETE.return: 0 on success, negative error code on failure

IPO_SYSCALL_FS_STAT.description: Retrieves metadata of specified path: size, extents, links, protection flags.
IPO_SYSCALL_FS_STAT.return: 0 on success, negative error code otherwise

IPO_SYSCALL_FS_LIST.description: Enumerates directory contents into formatted buffer.
IPO_SYSCALL_FS_LIST.return: Number of directory entries, or negative on error

IPO_SYSCALL_FS_RENAME.description: Renames or moves a file or directory within IPO_FS.

IPO_SYSCALL_FS_CLOSE.description: Closes file descriptor and flushes modified inode metadata.
IPO_SYSCALL_FS_CLOSE.return: 0 on success, negative error code on failure

IPO_SYSCALL_FS_SEEK.return: New absolute byte position, or negative on failure

IPO_SYSCALL_EXEC.description: Loads executable binary into allocated free memory block and dispatches new process.
IPO_SYSCALL_EXEC.return: PID of spawned process, or negative on error

IPO_SYSCALL_READ.description: Reads a line of user input from active terminal keyboard buffer.
IPO_SYSCALL_READ.return: Length of input string, or negative on error

IPO_SYSCALL_TERMINAL_INPUT.description: Injects keystroke text programmatically into terminal input buffer.
IPO_SYSCALL_TERMINAL_INPUT.return: 0 on success, negative error code on failure

IPO_SYSCALL_PROCESS_YIELD.description: Yields remainder of current CPU time slice to scheduler.

IPO_SYSCALL_PROCESS_IS_FOREGROUND.description: Checks if calling task is currently running in the active foreground.
IPO_SYSCALL_PROCESS_IS_FOREGROUND.return: 1 if process owns terminal display, 0 if background

IPO_SYSCALL_GETCWD.description: Gets canonical absolute path of process current working directory.
IPO_SYSCALL_GETCWD.return: String length copied, or negative error code

IPO_SYSCALL_CHDIR.description: Changes current working directory of process.
IPO_SYSCALL_CHDIR.return: 0 on success, negative error code if path invalid

IPO_SYSCALL_GET_EXIT_CODE.description: Returns exit code of last child process for shell piping and scripting.
IPO_SYSCALL_GET_EXIT_CODE.return: Exit code of last executed program

IPO_SYSCALL_PROCESS_IS_BATCH_ACTIVE.description: Queries whether multitasking batch mode (run & / &&) is running.

IPO_SYSCALL_SET_RETURN_VALUE.description: Sets explicit typed return value for the current process to pass through pipelines.
IPO_SYSCALL_SET_RETURN_VALUE.return: 0 on success, negative error code on failure

IPO_SYSCALL_GET_RETURN_VALUE.description: Retrieves formatted return string of the last finished child process.
IPO_SYSCALL_GET_RETURN_VALUE.return: Length of return string on success, negative error code on failure

IPO_SYSCALL_ASYNC_START.description: Registers a recurring kernel task with a caller-selected name and interval.
IPO_SYSCALL_ASYNC_START.return: Task ID handle (>= 0), or negative on failure

IPO_SYSCALL_ASYNC_STOP.description: Stops and unregisters background async task.
IPO_SYSCALL_ASYNC_STOP.return: 0 on success, negative error code otherwise

IPO_SYSCALL_STACK_GROW.description: Dynamically expands process stack allocation limit.
IPO_SYSCALL_STACK_GROW.return: 0 on success, negative on out of memory

IPO_SYSCALL_VAR_SET.description: Sets or creates persistent shared kernel system variable.

IPO_SYSCALL_VAR_GET.description: Retrieves value of named shared kernel variable.
IPO_SYSCALL_VAR_GET.return: Bytes copied, or negative if variable not found

IPO_SYSCALL_VAR_DELETE.description: Deletes shared system variable and reclaims memory.

IPO_SYSCALL_SBRK.description: Adjusts process data segment break for userspace malloc/free.
IPO_SYSCALL_SBRK.return: Previous heap break pointer, or (void*)-1 on out of memory

IPO_SYSCALL_TIME.description: Returns system uptime in seconds measured from kernel boot.

IPO_SYSCALL_FREE.description: Frees kernel-allocated memory buffer returned to userspace.

IPO_SYSCALL_ELAPSED_MS.description: Returns elapsed time using wrap-safe millisecond arithmetic.

IPO_SYSCALL_TIMER_AFTER.description: Checks whether the requested interval elapsed since start_ms.

IPO_SYSCALL_KEYMAP_SET.description: Registers dynamic keyboard layout with custom unicode glyphs.

IPO_SYSCALL_KEYMAP_GET.description: Gets identifier of currently active keyboard layout.
IPO_SYSCALL_KEYMAP_GET.return: Name length, or negative on error

IPO_SYSCALL_FONT_LOAD.description: Loads custom bitmap font into VGA character generator.

IPO_SYSCALL_KEYMAP_DISABLE.description: Disables keymap from layout switching rotation.

IPO_SYSCALL_KEYMAP_ENABLE.description: Enables previously disabled layout in switching rotation.

IPO_SYSCALL_KEYMAP_REMOVE.description: Removes and unregisters keymap completely from kernel.

IPO_SYSCALL_KEYMAP_TRANSLATE.description: Translates hardware scancode via active keymap translation table.
IPO_SYSCALL_KEYMAP_TRANSLATE.return: Translated character codepoint, or 0 if unmapped

IPO_SYSCALL_KEYMAP_IS_ACTIVE.description: Checks if specified keymap is currently active.
IPO_SYSCALL_KEYMAP_IS_ACTIVE.return: 1 if active, 0 if inactive, negative on error

IPO_SYSCALL_KEYMAP_CYCLE_NEXT.description: Cycles to next active keyboard layout and updates VGA language bar.

IPO_SYSCALL_KEYMAP_CYCLE_PREV.description: Cycles to previous active keyboard layout and updates VGA language bar.

IPO_SYSCALL_KEYMAP_GET_NAME.description: Gets active layout abbreviation (EN, RU, UA, ZH).

IPO_SYSCALL_FONT_GET_INFO.description: Queries loaded font family name and count of registered glyphs.
IPO_SYSCALL_FONT_GET_INFO.return: 0 on success, negative error code otherwise

IPO_SYSCALL_VGA_GLYPH.description: Renders custom unicode glyph to current screen cursor position.
IPO_SYSCALL_VGA_GLYPH.return: 0 on success, negative if glyph missing

IPO_SYSCALL_VGA_SET_MODE.description: Switches display video mode and reconfigures DAC / Framebuffer.

IPO_SYSCALL_VGA_GET_MODE.description: Queries currently active video display mode.

IPO_SYSCALL_SYSTEM_INTERRUPT.description: Performs hardware system control: 8042 reboot, ACPI shutdown, crash dump.
IPO_SYSCALL_SYSTEM_INTERRUPT.return: 0 on success, or does not return

IPO_SYSCALL_DRIVER_REGISTER.description: Registers runtime device driver and connects its subsystem hooks.
IPO_SYSCALL_DRIVER_REGISTER.return: Registration index (>= 0), or negative on error

IPO_SYSCALL_DRIVER_UNREGISTER.description: Detaches hooks and unloads dynamic runtime driver.
IPO_SYSCALL_DRIVER_UNREGISTER.return: 0 on success, negative error code otherwise

IPO_SYSCALL_DRIVER_LIST.description: Lists all registered device drivers and active subsystem hooks.

IPO_SYSCALL_DRIVER_SET_DESC.description: Sets descriptive text metadata for registered driver.

IPO_SYSCALL_FS_STATVFS.description: Queries mounted IPO_FS storage pool block and inode capacity statistics.

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_CREATE_WINDOW.description: Creates managed desktop window with titlebar, borders, framebuffer and event callbacks.
IPO_SYSCALL_WM_CREATE_WINDOW.return: Pointer to allocated wm_window_t, or NULL on error

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_DESTROY_WINDOW.description: Closes and destroys window, releasing its framebuffer and compositor nodes.

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_SESSION_START.description: Enters VGA Mode 13h, allocates a backbuffer, and starts the compositor session.

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_SESSION_STOP.description: Stops WM compositor task, destroys all open windows and restores text mode.

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_SESSION_ACTIVE.description: Checks whether GUI Window Manager desktop session is running.
IPO_SYSCALL_WM_SESSION_ACTIVE.return: 1 if GUI session active, 0 if in text mode

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_GET_COUNT.description: Returns total number of active windows in compositor list.

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_GET_FOCUSED.description: Gets top-level window handle currently possessing user input focus.
IPO_SYSCALL_WM_GET_FOCUSED.return: Pointer to focused window, or NULL

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_SET_FOCUS.description: Raises window to top of z-order and sets input focus.

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_FOCUS_NEXT.description: Cycles focus forward to next window in z-order (Alt+Tab behavior).

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_FOCUS_PREV.description: Cycles focus backward to previous window in z-order.

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_INVALIDATE.description: Marks window dirty, triggering redraw in next compositor frame.

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_IS_VALID.description: Checks whether window handle exists in active compositor list.

IPO_SYSCALL_GETPID.description: Returns unique process ID (PID) of calling task.

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_TOGGLE_MAXIMIZE.description: Toggles window between fullscreen maximized and floating geometry.

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_RESIZE.description: Resizes window dimensions and reallocates pixel framebuffer.
IPO_SYSCALL_WM_RESIZE.return: 1 on success, 0 on memory allocation failure

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_GET_LIST.description: Returns pointer to head of active window list.
IPO_SYSCALL_WM_GET_LIST.return: Pointer to head of active window list, or NULL if empty

IPO_SYSCALL_PROCESS_SWITCH_FG.description: Switches foreground terminal screen buffer and focus to specified PID.
IPO_SYSCALL_PROCESS_SWITCH_FG.return: 0 on success, negative if PID not found

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_INIT.description: Initializes the window list when it is empty.

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_INVALIDATE_ALL.description: Marks every window as needing redraw.

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_SET_FULLSCREEN.description: Enables or disables fullscreen mode for a window.

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_MOVE.description: Moves a window to the specified position.

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_SET_SHAPE.description: Sets the window shape mask and its dimensions.

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_DISPATCH_KEY.description: Routes a keyboard scancode through the window manager.

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_COMPOSE.description: Composes windows and overlays into the supplied backbuffer.

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_SESSION_RUN.description: Runs the blocking, animated window-manager session.

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_GET_COUNT_PID.description: Returns the number of windows owned by a process.
IPO_SYSCALL_WM_GET_COUNT_PID.return: Number of windows owned by the process

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_HAS_WINDOWS_PID.description: Checks whether a process owns any windows.
IPO_SYSCALL_WM_HAS_WINDOWS_PID.return: 1 if the process owns windows, otherwise 0

IPO_SYSCALL_WM_FOCUS_PID.description: Focuses a window owned by the specified process.

IPO_SYSCALL_NET_DNS_RESOLVE.description: Resolves a hostname using the configured DNS server.

IPO_SYSCALL_NET_ICMP_SEND.return: ICMP send result, or negative on error

IPO_SYSCALL_NET_ICMP_POLL.description: Waits for an ICMP echo reply matching the identifier and sequence.
IPO_SYSCALL_NET_ICMP_POLL.return: 1 if a matching reply is received, otherwise 0

IPO_SYSCALL_NET_SOCKET.return: Socket descriptor, or negative on error

IPO_SYSCALL_NET_BIND.description: Assigns a local address to a socket.

IPO_SYSCALL_NET_LISTEN.description: Marks a bound stream socket as listening for connections.

IPO_SYSCALL_NET_ACCEPT.description: Accepts an incoming connection, optionally waiting up to timeout_ms.
IPO_SYSCALL_NET_ACCEPT.return: Connected socket descriptor, or negative on error/timeout

IPO_SYSCALL_NET_CONNECT.description: Connects a socket to a remote address.

IPO_SYSCALL_NET_SEND.description: Sends data through a connected socket.
IPO_SYSCALL_NET_SEND.return: Number of bytes sent, or negative on error

IPO_SYSCALL_NET_RECV.description: Receives data from a connected socket.
IPO_SYSCALL_NET_RECV.return: Number of bytes received, or negative on error

IPO_SYSCALL_NET_CLOSE.description: Closes a socket and releases its kernel resources.

IPO_SYSCALL_NET_CONNECT_ENDPOINT.description: Resolves the endpoint if needed and connects the socket.

IPO_SYSCALL_NET_POLL.description: Polls the network device and processes pending network work.

IPO_SYSCALL_NET_GET_INTERFACE.description: Copies network interface configuration and link state to userspace.
IPO_SYSCALL_NET_GET_INTERFACE.return: 1 on success, 0 on failure (or pointer to cached net_if_t in C API)

IPO_SYSCALL_NET_INIT.description: Initializes network subsystems using capacities supplied by the caller.

IPO_SYSCALL_NET_SET_IP.description: Updates the network interface IPv4 configuration.

IPO_SYSCALL_KBD_GET_SCANCODE.description: Pulls next available raw hardware scancode non-blocking.
IPO_SYSCALL_KBD_GET_SCANCODE.return: Next scancode from queue or 0 if queue empty

IPO_SYSCALL_KBD_WAIT_SCANCODE.description: Blocks calling process until a keyboard scancode is received.

IPO_SYSCALL_KBD_SET_APP_MODE.description: Switches keyboard focus between terminal shell and raw application mode.

IPO_SYSCALL_KBD_FLUSH.description: Flushes all kernel keyboard queues, 8042 hardware buffers, and modifier states.

IPO_SYSCALL_KBD_GET_MODIFIERS.description: Returns current state bitmask of keyboard modifier keys.
IPO_SYSCALL_KBD_GET_MODIFIERS.return: Bitmask of active modifier keys (Shift, Ctrl, Alt, CapsLock, NumLock, ScrollLock)

IPO_SYSCALL_KBD_POLL.description: Polls 8042 keyboard controller ports and dispatches pending events.

IPO_SYSCALL_KBD_GET_KEY_STRING.description: Resolves human-readable name string for a hardware scancode (e.g. "Enter", "Space").
IPO_SYSCALL_KBD_GET_KEY_STRING.return: 1 on copy to buffer, or kernel string pointer if no buffer provided

IPO_SYSCALL_MOUSE_GET_STATE.description: Retrieves current PS/2 mouse coordinates, button click states, and wheel delta.

IPO_SYSCALL_VGA_SET_CURSOR.description: Sets hardware CRTC text mode cursor position via ports 0x3D4/0x3D5.

IPO_SYSCALL_VGA_GET_CURSOR.description: Reads hardware text mode cursor position from CRTC registers.

IPO_SYSCALL_VGA_SHOW_CURSOR.description: Enables and shows the hardware text mode blinking cursor.

IPO_SYSCALL_VGA_HIDE_CURSOR.description: Disables and hides the hardware text mode cursor.

IPO_SYSCALL_VGA_SET_PALETTE.description: Programs 6-bit RGB values into the VGA DAC palette registers (ports 0x3C8/0x3C9).

IPO_SYSCALL_VGA_SET_OVERLAY_FLAGS.description: Sets overlay visibility flags for raw VGA Mode 13h processes (hiding Close button or mouse cursor).

IPO_SYSCALL_VGA_GET_OVERLAY_FLAGS.description: Returns current VGA overlay visibility flags for the active process.

IPO_SYSCALL_AUDIO_INIT.description: Initializes the Sound Blaster 16 DSP, DMA Channel 5, and software mixer.

IPO_SYSCALL_AUDIO_TICK.description: Advances audio playback stream mixer and refills DMA buffers.

IPO_SYSCALL_AUDIO_STOP_ALL.description: Stops all active audio playback streams and halts Sound Blaster 16 DMA.

IPO_SYSCALL_AUDIO_STREAM_CREATE.description: Creates a static in-memory audio playback stream.
IPO_SYSCALL_AUDIO_STREAM_CREATE.return: Pointer to audio_stream_t handle, or NULL on error

IPO_SYSCALL_AUDIO_STREAM_CREATE_RING.description: Creates a continuous ring-buffered audio stream for dynamic real-time playback.
IPO_SYSCALL_AUDIO_STREAM_CREATE_RING.return: Pointer to audio_stream_t handle, or NULL on error

IPO_SYSCALL_AUDIO_STREAM_DESTROY.description: Stops playback, unlinks, and frees an audio stream handle.

IPO_SYSCALL_AUDIO_STREAM_PLAY.description: Starts or resumes playback of an audio stream.

IPO_SYSCALL_AUDIO_STREAM_PAUSE.description: Pauses playback of an audio stream preserving current position.

IPO_SYSCALL_AUDIO_STREAM_STOP.description: Stops playback and rewinds audio stream position to beginning.

IPO_SYSCALL_AUDIO_STREAM_SEEK.description: Seeks playback position within an audio stream.

IPO_SYSCALL_AUDIO_STREAM_SET_VOL.description: Adjusts individual playback volume of an audio stream.

IPO_SYSCALL_AUDIO_STREAM_PROGRESS.description: Queries current playback progress of an audio stream.

IPO_SYSCALL_AUDIO_STREAM_UPDATE.description: Appends or updates buffer data in a streaming ring-buffer.

IPO_SYSCALL_BINFMT_REGISTER.description: Registers dynamic executable binary format handler with signature matching, delegating non-native execution to an interpreter.
IPO_SYSCALL_BINFMT_REGISTER.return: 0 on success, or negative error code

IPO_SYSCALL_BINFMT_UNREGISTER.description: Unregisters a previously registered dynamic binary format handler by name.
IPO_SYSCALL_BINFMT_UNREGISTER.return: 0 on success, or negative error code

IPO_SYSCALL_BINFMT_LIST.description: Enumerates and lists all currently registered dynamic binary format handlers.
IPO_SYSCALL_BINFMT_LIST.return: Count of active registered binary format handlers

IPO_SYSCALL_EXIT.description: Terminates calling process, releases memory and switches context.
